strategy_lineage: calendar-alignment repair of ATM-SVP2-US-MQ-ROLE-001; frozen production-path U.S. style-role substitution on nfci-dual-core-v11 / dualcore-v11-2026-08-15
hypothesis: The exact two frozen MTUM/QUAL broad-U.S.-equity role substitutions from ATM-SVP2-US-MQ-ROLE-001 can be evaluated after correcting only the union-calendar alignment bug that invalidated the predecessor before candidate performance was recorded. No economic candidate rule is changed.

repair_scope.bug: the hybrid role constructor required a style ETF quote on every date in the multi-market union S&P role calendar and terminated on 11 holiday/weekend dates with no same-date MTUM/QUAL print
repair_scope.only_fix: align the style ETF to the union calendar by carrying the last available adjusted close forward on dates with no new ETF quote; that union-calendar day's style-role return is zero, and the next quoted session realizes the full close-to-close ETF return
repair_scope.forbidden_as_repair: no instrument, start date, substitution fraction, target path, cost, gate, fold, or statistical threshold change

allowed_changes: replace only the predecessor's same-date-quote requirement with last-observation carry-forward for non-quote union-calendar dates
reuse the exact frozen MTUM and QUAL adjusted-close files and all original production V11/NFCI inputs
reuse exactly the 2013-07-19 substitution start and 100% sp500 realized-return role substitution
reuse the identical V11 signal dates, event dates, target weights, USD/CNY conversion, fees, slippage, rebalance band, cash treatment and risk reductions
selection_metric: No winner selection or survivor reporting. MTUM and QUAL are independently compared with the same production-path V11 over 2013-07-19+ and both remain in G3/global multiple-testing accounting regardless of outcome. The INVALID predecessor remains in the ledger as an attempted formal run but contributes no Sharpe value to DSR because no candidate performance was produced.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe in the same fold

deterministic: source production V11 full daily target fingerprint exactly equals ba67c8aa24bc7168; each candidate execution-event target fingerprint exactly equals the source execution-event target fingerprint; gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
bootstrap on 2013-07-19+ behavior: paired circular moving blocks versus V11, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO/winner-selection test: not applicable because both preregistered roles are independently reported and no family winner is selected

global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using the 36 prior performance-bearing formal return-seeking candidates plus both repair candidates, total DSR Sharpe vector 38; the invalid predecessor remains visible in G3 ledger accounting but has no performance value to insert
ROBUST_STRATEGY_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: After either repair result is opened, do not change the 2013-07-19 substitution start, ETF, role, carry-forward rule, substitution percentage, V11 target path, evaluation window, momentum/quality weighting, blend candidates with each other or S&P, add another style ETF, or introduce style timing. No second repair is allowed unless a new implementation defect is demonstrated independently of performance; any economic change is a new campaign and trial count.
